ai.literal: Do not begin any action, do not despise, besieging place having seen after except.
ai.translation: Do not begin any action, nor underestimate the enemy, until you have found the right place to besiege them.
ai.modern: முற்றுகையிடுவதற்கு ஏற்ற இடத்தைக் கண்டறிந்த பிறகு அல்லாமல், எந்த ஒரு செயலையும் தொடங்கக் கூடாது; பகையை எளிதாக எண்ணவும் கூடாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet advises against taking premature action or underestimating an opponent before securing a strategic position. The word 'முற்றும்' refers to besieging or completely overcoming the enemy. Until the right place ('இடம்') is found ('கண்ட பின் அல்லது'), one must neither start the campaign ('தொடங்கற்க') nor despise the enemy's strength ('எள்ளற்க').

ai.literal: Battle possessing even to those of strength, fortress having reached becoming advantage many will give.
ai.translation: Even to those possessing formidable strength in battle, reaching a fortress will yield many advantages.
ai.modern: போரில் வெற்றிபெறும் வலிமை உடையவர்களுக்கும், ஒரு அரணை அடைந்து செயல்படுவது பல நன்மைகளைத் தரும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the strategic importance of a secure location, specifically a fortress, regardless of one's inherent power. The phrase 'முரண் சேர்ந்த மொய்ம்பினவர்க்கும்' refers to warriors who already possess immense, battle-hardened strength. One might assume such powerful fighters do not need defensive structures. However, the couplet explains that the advantage gained by operating from a stronghold ('அரண் சேர்ந்தாம் ஆக்கம்') is substantial, as it multiplies their natural strength and yields many successes.

ai.literal: Even the weak, having become strong, will conquer, place having known, at the enemies, having protected, if they act.
ai.translation: Even the weak will gather strength and conquer their foes, if they choose the right place, protect themselves, and then act.
ai.modern: தக்க இடத்தினை அறிந்து, தம்மைக் காத்துக்கொண்டு பகைவரிடம் போர் செய்தால், வலிமையற்றவர்களும் வலிமை பெற்று வெல்வார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the strategic advantage of choosing the right battleground. The word 'இடன்' (place) is central, emphasizing that location can compensate for a lack of inherent power. If even weak people ('ஆற்றாரும்') carefully protect themselves ('போற்றி') and engage their enemies in a well-chosen place, they will gather strength ('ஆற்றி') and achieve victory ('அடுப'). It highlights that tactical positioning and self-defense are just as crucial as raw strength.

ai.literal: Those who planned, their plan will lose, place having known, those who reached it, having stayed close if they act.
ai.translation: If defenders know the right place and act while holding it firmly, those who planned against them will lose all hopes of victory.
ai.modern: தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, அதைப் பொருந்தி நின்று செயல்பட்டால், பகைவர்கள் தங்களை வெல்ல நினைத்த எண்ணத்தை இழந்து தோற்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of choosing and holding the right ground. The word 'இடன்' refers to a suitable place, while the root 'துன்னு' means to approach, fit, or stay close. If defenders secure a strong position and act firmly from within it, the attackers ('எண்ணியார்' - those who planned the assault) will see their plans completely fail. The repetition of 'துன்னியார் துன்னி' emphasizes the need to not just reach the right place, but to stay firmly rooted there during the action.

ai.literal: deep in water will conquer crocodile will kill from water if leaves it others
ai.translation: In deep water, a crocodile can conquer anything. But if it leaves the water, other creatures will defeat it.
ai.modern: ஆழமான நீரில் இருக்கும்போது முதலை மற்ற உயிரினங்களை வெல்லும். ஆனால் அந்த நீரை விட்டு வெளியே வந்தால், மற்ற உயிரினங்கள் அந்த முதலையை வென்றுவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet illustrates the absolute importance of choosing the right environment for success. In its natural habitat of deep water, a crocodile is invincible and can defeat any opponent. However, if it steps out of the water, it loses its natural advantage and becomes vulnerable to other animals. The imagery emphasizes that even the strongest individuals can be easily defeated if they operate outside their domain of strength.

ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of choosing the right battleground. Even if a leader has only a small army, securing an advantageous position gives them a critical edge. The contrast between a small army and a mighty army emphasizes that location can overcome sheer numbers.

ai.literal: Leg sinking in marsh, jackal will kill eye not-fearing spear warrior facing elephant.
ai.translation: In a marsh where its legs sink, even a jackal can kill a mighty elephant that fearlessly faces spear-bearing warriors.
ai.modern: கால்கள் ஆழமாகப் புதையும் சேற்று நிலத்தில் அகப்பட்டால், வேல் ஏந்திய வீரர்களைக் கண்டும் அஞ்சாத வலிமையான யானையை ஒரு சிறிய நரி கூடக் கொன்றுவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet illustrates the absolute importance of choosing the right battleground. A mighty elephant that fearlessly charges at warriors armed with spears becomes completely helpless if it gets stuck in a deep marsh. In such an unsuitable place, even a lowly, weak jackal can easily kill the great beast. The contrast between the fearless elephant and the weak jackal emphasizes that strength is useless in the wrong environment.
